text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Hanshin JF, even though 
it was her first time on the grand GⅠ 
stage, Mejiro Dober was remarkably 
composed—even to her own surprise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of her vow with Mejiro 
Bright, she needed a result that would 
give her the confidence to move forward. 
With fighting spirit burning in her heart, 
Mejiro Dober headed into the race.
